0022600122.text: The Heat (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) host the Mavericks (1-2, on a one-game losing streak) with Miami 2 games back in the Southeast and 15th in the East, while Dallas is 2 games back in the Southwest and 12th in the West. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their last meeting was a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
